name: io.github.Sanflow10/adversary-gate
title: AdversaryGate
description: Fail-closed merge gate an agent calls before saying done: MERGE, BLOCK or INCONCLUSIVE.

environmentVariables.name: ADVERSARY_GATE_BASE_REF
environmentVariables.description: Baseline git ref (e.g. origin/main). Unset, the agent may pick it, and whoever picks the baseline picks the oracle

environmentVariables.name: ADVERSARY_GATE_PYTHON
environmentVariables.description: Interpreter that runs the tests; must be one the agent cannot write to

environmentVariables.name: ADVERSARY_GATE_POLICY
environmentVariables.description: Extra gate flags set by the operator; evidence flags are refused
